title: disphyma australe
intro: Disphyma australe, commonly known as New Zealand pear, is a succulent plant native to the coastal regions of New Zealand and Australia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for skin issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of Disphyma australe include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
